checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Image 1 has two handles, a straight cylinder; image 2 has one handle and a slightly different shape; image 3 is matte and one-handled.

must.item: Main image whole mug on pure white
must.why: Whole mug on white, though it has two handles and a faint shadow.
Mug on a wooden table with croissants, jam and a napkin in warm light.
Macro of the rim and glaze, though the finish looks more matte.

faults.what: The white-background mug has two handles, while the other shots show one handle. It is not the same mug, and a two-handled mug is wrong for a plain mug.
The glaze finish differs: glossy in images 1 and 2, matte and satin in image 3.
The close-up background is grey, not white. The user did not ask for white there.

summary: The breakfast and close-up images look good, but the hero shot shows a two-handled mug that doesn't match the single-handled mug in the other two, so the set isn't consistent.
